# Remote (in-container) deps for safety/modal_safety_test on Modal.
# Pared down from the pins used for the local replication: dropped the vLLM/Together
# judge stack (litellm, python-dotenv), the CE-loss data stack (datasets, pandas,
# zstandard), plots (matplotlib), and pipeline-only typing (jaxtyping, typeguard,
# transformers-stream-generator). What remains loads a HF causal-LM, runs harness.py
# + steering_primitives.py, and the HarmBench classifier.
#
# transformers 4.53.0, bumped from 4.44.2 because Qwen3-1.7B / Qwen3-8B / Qwen3-30B-A3B
# (the Stage B sweep) require >=4.51.
#
# HONEST SCOPE OF WHAT WAS TESTED (2026-07-19): an earlier comment here claimed the old
# 4.44.2 pin was "verified false" for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B. That was WRONG and is
# retracted. The gibberish that prompted it was a local bug -- app.py::collect loaded the
# requested model's TOKENIZER but the hardcoded MODEL_PATH's WEIGHTS, so an "8B" run was
# really 8B-tokenizer + 1.5B-weights. Symptom: degenerate single-token repetition, and a
# load line reporting 28 layers / d=1536 (the 1.5B) under the 8B's name. Once fixed, the
# 8B loads correctly (32 layers / d=4096) and refuses coherently ON THIS 4.53.0 PIN.
# Whether it ALSO worked on 4.44.2 was never tested and is not claimed either way -- the
# bump is justified by the Qwen3 requirement alone.

# --- core: model + steering + harness ---
torch==2.3.0
transformers==4.53.0
accelerate==1.8.1         # 0.31 is too old for transformers 4.53
safetensors==0.5.3
huggingface-hub==0.33.0   # transformers 4.53 needs >=0.30
sentencepiece==0.2.0
protobuf==5.27.1
numpy==1.26.4           # harness.py

# --- tokenizer/runtime insurance for the Qwen family ---
tiktoken==0.7.0
einops==0.8.0

# --- misc ---
tqdm==4.66.4
